brief:
Palestinian journalist Mahmoud Mushtaha said October 7th should not be marked as an anniversary because the violence and displacement that followed the date have never ceased, Middle East Eye reported. Mushtaha characterized the ongoing situation in Gaza as a continuation rather than a commemoration of events from that day.

His statement reflects the experience of Palestinians in Gaza who have endured sustained conflict, humanitarian conditions, and displacement since October 2023.
dek: October 7th never ended for Gaza, Palestinian journalist says Palestinian journalist Mahmoud Mushtaha said October 7th is not an anniversary because its aftermath never ended for Gaza.
title: Palestinian journalist says Gaza's October 7 aftermath continues unbroken
